data.name: Allistir
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Ἀλλοστόρικος (Allostorikos), meaning 'other-ruler' or 'rule of God'. In early Christian use, this name was given to those who ruled in the name of God or to those who were protectors of the faith.
